drink tea: My grandmother likes to drink tea after dinner every evening.
我奶奶喜欢每天晚饭后喝茶。
the United States: Her cousin moved to the United States two years ago.
她的表哥两年前搬到了美国。
Dragon Boat Festival: We eat rice dumplings during the Dragon Boat Festival every year.
每年端午节我们都吃粽子。
take a message: He is not here, but I can take a message for you.
他不在这儿，但我可以帮你捎个口信。
call(sb)back: I will call you back as soon as I finish my homework.
我一做完作业就给你回电话。
on(a)vacation: They are on vacation at the beach this week.
police station: The lost boy was taken to the police station by a kind man.
那个迷路的男孩被一位好心人带到了警察局。
pay phone: Is there a pay phone near the bus stop?
公交车站附近有付费电话吗？
across from: The bank is across from the library, so it is easy to find.
银行在图书馆对面，所以很容易找到。
go along: Go along this street and you will see the hospital on your left.
沿着这条街走，你就会看到医院在你的左边。
turn right/left: Turn right at the second crossing and the school is in front of you.
在第二个路口右转，学校就在你面前。
spend time: I like to spend time with my family on weekends.
周末我喜欢和家人一起度过时光。
enjoy reading: Most of my classmates enjoy reading books in the school library.
我的大多数同学都喜欢在学校图书馆读书。
of medium height: The man of medium height is our new English teacher.
那个中等身高的男人是我们的新英语老师。
of medium build: My brother is of medium build and wears glasses.
我哥哥中等身材，戴着眼镜。
a little: Don't worry, I still have a little money in my pocket.
别担心，我口袋里还有一点钱。
in the end: They worked hard, and in the end they passed the exam.
他们努力学习，最后通过了考试。
would like: I would like a cup of coffee and some bread, please.
麻烦给我来一杯咖啡和一些面包。
take one's order: The waiter came over to take our order quickly.
服务员很快过来为我们点菜。
one(large)bowl of: He ordered one large bowl of beef noodles for lunch.
他午餐点了一大碗牛肉面。
around the world: People around the world love watching football games.
世界各地的人都喜欢看足球比赛。
make a wish: Close your eyes and make a wish before you blow out the candles.
吹蜡烛前先闭上眼睛许个愿。
blow out: The little girl could not blow out all the candles at once.
小女孩不能一次吹灭所有的蜡烛。
the UK: His uncle studied in the UK for three years.
他叔叔在英国学习了三年。
get popular: Online shopping is getting popular in small towns.
网购在小城镇越来越流行。
cut up: Please cut up the vegetables before you cook them.
bring good luck to…: People believe red paper cuts can bring good luck to the family.
人们相信红色剪纸能给家人带来好运。
milk a cow: The farmer showed us how to milk a cow on his farm.
农夫在农场里向我们展示如何给奶牛挤奶。
ride a horse: It was my first time to ride a horse, and I felt a little nervous.
那是我第一次骑马，我感到有点紧张。
feed chickens: Every morning my grandpa gets up early to feed chickens.
每天早上我爷爷都早早起床去喂鸡。
quite a lot(of…): We learned quite a lot of new words in this English class.
在这节英语课上我们学了许多新单词。
in the countryside: My family often spends the summer in the countryside.
我们一家经常在乡下过夏天。
fire station: The children visited the fire station and learned a lot about fire safety.
孩子们参观了消防站，学到了很多消防安全知识。
all in all: The trip was tiring, but all in all we had a great time.
这次旅行很累，但总的来说我们玩得很开心。
be interested in: She is interested in science and wants to be a scientist.
她对科学感兴趣，想成为一名科学家。
stay up late: It is bad for your health to stay up late playing games.
熬夜打游戏对你的健康有害。
run away: The thief tried to run away, but the police caught him at last.
小偷想跑开，但警察最终抓住了他。
shout at…: It is not polite to shout at your parents when you disagree.
意见不一致时对父母大声叫嚷是不礼貌的。
fly a kite: In spring, many children fly a kite on the playground.
春天，许多孩子在操场上放风筝。
high school: My sister will go to high school next September.
我姐姐明年九月上中学。
